Refund & Cancellation Policy

Effective 5 October 2026 · Version 2026-10-05

This policy explains when you can cancel a purchase on AstroBro and how refunds work. It is part of our Terms of Use.

In short: plans never renew automatically. Requests nobody answers are free. Unanswered chats are refunded automatically. Bookings cancelled before we confirm them are refunded in full. Money taken by mistake is always returned.

1. Premium plans

  • Plans are one-time payments for a fixed period: 7 days for ₹49, 30 days for ₹149, 90 days for ₹399 or 365 days for ₹999. They never renew automatically, so there is no subscription to cancel. When a plan ends you return to the free tier.
  • A plan starts as soon as the payment is confirmed. Because its benefits are available straight away, a plan that has been activated is not refundable, except in these cases:
    • Payment taken but plan not activated: we activate the plan or refund the payment in full.
    • Duplicate payment for the same plan: we refund the extra payment.
    • A fault on our side that stops you using the plan and that we cannot fix: we refund the unused days.
    • We withdraw a plan feature before your plan ends: we refund the unused part or give you an equal credit.

2. Detailed PDF report

  • If a report cannot be generated after you pay, your payment stays valid and the app lets you try again. If we still cannot deliver the report within 7 days, we refund the payment in full.
  • Once a report has been delivered it is not refundable, unless it is wrong because of an error on our side (for example, the chart does not match the birth details you entered). In that case we fix the report or refund it.

3. Wallet top-ups

  • Money you add is credited to your wallet as soon as Razorpay confirms the payment.
  • Payment taken but not credited: the app retries automatically. If the money still does not appear, write to us and we will credit it or refund it to your payment method after checking with Razorpay.
  • Unused balance: you can ask for the unused balance you added to be refunded to the original payment method. Where that is not possible, we refund it to a bank account or UPI ID in your name.
  • Wallet balance cannot be transferred to anyone else or withdrawn as cash.

4. Consultations with astrologers

  • You pay per minute from your wallet, at the rate shown before you start.
  • No charge for a request the astrologer does not accept.
  • Automatic full refund to your wallet if the astrologer accepts a chat but never sends a message.
  • Technical failure on our side: if a session breaks because of a fault on our side, write to us within 7 days and we refund the minutes affected.
  • Misconduct: if an astrologer is abusive, asks for money outside AstroBro, promises guaranteed results, frightens you into buying remedies, or is not present during the session, report it within 7 days. If the complaint is upheld, we refund the session to your wallet.
  • Not liking a reading is not, on its own, a reason for a refund, because astrological advice is a matter of interpretation.

5. Puja and pandit bookings

  • Before we confirm the booking: cancel in the app (My Bookings) for a full refund to your wallet.
  • After confirmation, more than 24 hours before the scheduled time: write to us for a full refund to your wallet.
  • After confirmation, less than 24 hours before the scheduled time: we can move the booking to another date once at no cost. A refund is then at our discretion, because the pandit has already set the time aside.
  • If we cancel, or the pandit does not come: full refund.
  • You can ask for a booking refund to go to your original payment method instead of your wallet.

6. Failed and duplicate payments

If money leaves your account but the payment fails, your bank or Razorpay usually returns it automatically within 5 to 7 working days. If it does not, write to us with the payment ID.

7. How to ask for a refund

Email [support_email not set] from your registered email address with:

  • what you bought and when;
  • the Razorpay payment ID (it starts with "pay_") or the consultation or booking shown in the app;
  • what went wrong.

We acknowledge your request within 48 hours and give you a decision within 15 days. Approved refunds to your wallet are immediate. Refunds to your bank, card or UPI are started within 7 working days of approval; your bank may take a few more days to show them.

8. Chargebacks

Please contact us before you raise a chargeback with your bank. Raising a chargeback for a service you received may lead to your account being suspended.

9. Still not satisfied?

See Grievance Redressal for how to escalate a complaint, including the National Consumer Helpline (1915).
